    "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-06/schema#",
    "title": "IGF metadata validation schema",
    "description": "Schema for validation of metadata input file",
    "type": "array",
    "version": "1.0.1",
    "minItems": 1,
    "_uniqueItems": true,
    "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "project_igf_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^IGF[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$",
                "maxLength": 50
            },
            "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^\\w+\\s\\w+\\s?\\w+?$"
            },
            "hpc_username": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^\\S+$|^$"
            },
            "username": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^\\S+$|^$",
                "maxLength": 10
            },
            "email_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "\\S+\\@\\S+\\.\\w+"
            },
            "sample_igf_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^IGF[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$"
            },
            "sample_submitter_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$",
                "maxLength": 40
            },
            "barcode_check": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                    "ON",
                    "OFF",
                    ""
                ]
            },
            "species_name": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                    "HG38",
                    "HG19",
                    "HG19_MM10",

            "taxon_id": {

            "scientific_name": {

            "trait": {
                "type": "string"
            },
            "population": {
                "type": "string"
            },
            "sex": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                    "FEMALE",
                    "MALE",
                    "MIXED",
                    "UNKNOWN",
                    ""
                ]
            },
            "donor_age": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^(\\d+)?\\-?(\\d+)?\\w+$|^$"
            },
            "biomaterial_type": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                    "PRIMARY_TISSUE",
                    "PRIMARY_CELL",
                    "PRIMARY_CELL_CULTURE",
                    "CELL_LINE",
                    "SINGLE_NUCLEI",
                    "UNKNOWN",
                    ""
                ]
            },
            "cell_type": {
                "type": "string"
            },
            "tissue_type": {
                "type": "string"
            },
            "cell_line": {
                "type": "string"
            },
            "expected_reads": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^(\\d+)?$|^$"
            },
            "expected_lanes": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^(\\d+)?$|^$"
            }
        },
        "required": [
            "project_igf_id",
            "name",
            "email_id",
            "sample_igf_id"
        ]
    }
}
